questions:
1. **Where the "Underline" toggle is shown.** Suggested: when a text, a shape with text or an arrow with a label is selected, or the Text tool is active. It is not shown for shapes without text or when nothing is selected. It is a single toggle with the label and tooltip "Underline".
2. **Ctrl+U / Cmd+U shortcut and the browser conflict.** In most browsers Ctrl+U opens the page source. Suggested: when the canvas has focus and a text-bearing element is selected, or a text is being edited, Ctrl+U (Cmd+U on macOS) toggles underline and the browser does not open the page source. With nothing selected, Ctrl+U does nothing in the app.
3. **Whole element only.** Suggested: underline is one property of the whole text element. If the user selects part of the text in the editor and presses Ctrl+U, the whole element is underlined. There is no underline for part of a text.
4. **Multi-line and wrapped text.** Suggested: each line gets its own underline, as wide as that line's text, and it follows the text align setting (left, center, right). Empty lines get no underline.
5. **Position and thickness.** Suggested: the line thickness and distance from the text scale with font size. The underline sits just below the baseline and may cross descenders (g, y, p). It is never clipped by the shape border or the export edges.
6. **Color.** Suggested: the underline always has the text's stroke color and opacity. It updates when the color changes.
7. **Several selected texts with different values.** Suggested: the toggle shows a mixed (not active) state. One click underlines all of them, and a second click removes the underline from all.
8. **Default for new text.** Suggested: like the other text styles, the last chosen underline value becomes the default for new text.
9. **Sticky notes.** Suggested: underline works on sticky note labels and does not change auto-fit. The underline stays inside the note when the label is shown smaller.
10. **Copies, styles and history.** Suggested: copy styles / paste styles, Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V, Ctrl+D, Alt+drag and library items keep underline. One toggle is undone with a single undo.
11. **Leaving the session.** Suggested: underline survives reload, a saved .excalidraw file, PNG and SVG export (also when the SVG is opened on another computer) and live collaboration. An older Excalidraw version opening such a file shows the text without underline and with no error.
12. **Scripts.** Suggested: right-to-left text (Arabic, Hebrew), CJK text and emoji get an unbroken underline across the whole line. The underline starts and ends at the line's real edges.
13. **Interface language.** Suggested: in locales without a translation, the "Underline" label and tooltip fall back to English, never to an empty label or a raw key.
14. **Small screens and touch.** Suggested: the toggle is in the mobile properties panel at 375 px width without overlap, and a tap toggles it.
15. **Italic (issue 11404, not released).** Suggested: combining underline with italic is out of scope until italic ships. A note will list it as not covered.
